🌍 Pakistan interior minister departs for Iran

📌 Islamabad, IRNA – Pakistan’s Interior Minister Syed Mohsin Raza Naqvi has left Islamabad for Tehran to hold talks with senior Iranian officials.

Naqvi left Islamabad on Monday to meet high‑ranking Iranian authorities and follow up on bilateral cooperation.
​
The visit aims to advance discussions on expanding ties and coordinating ongoing matters between the two neighboring countries.
​
Naqvi has made several trips to Tehran since Pakistan began its mediation efforts between Iran and the United States.
​
During his latest visit on August 10, he met President Masoud Pezeshkian, Major General Mohsen Rezaei, Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, and Iran’s Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni.

🎙 Judiciary chief offers condolences over passing of Ayatollah Shobeiri Zanjani

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Judiciary Chief Gholamhossein Mohseni-Ejei has issued a message offering condolences over the passing of prominent Shia cleric and source of emulation Ayatollah Seyyed Mousa Shobeiri Zanjani.

Mohseni-Ejei issued the message on Monday, offering condolences to all sources of emulation, clerics, seminaries, and Shia Muslims.
​
He praised the late cleric for his distinguished character, significant contributions to Islamic jurisprudence, and efforts to train renowned scholars in the field.
​
The office of Ayatollah Seyyed Mousa Shobeiri Zanjani confirmed his passing in an announcement earlier on Monday.
​
The office said details of the funeral and burial ceremonies would be announced later.
